statement_record.book: Systems on a fixed point set are ordered by A ≤ B iff every pair connected in A is connected in B; the five three-point systems form a Hasse diagram from the discrete to the fully connected system. Relative to this order the join defined earlier is exactly the least upper bound: A ≤ A∨B, B ≤ A∨B, and A∨B ≤ C whenever A ≤ C and B ≤ C.
statement_record.intree: The coproduct UMP (ump_products read in C^op) supplies precisely the three lub clauses, with inl/inr the two 'A ≤ A∨B' arrows and merge the mediating 'A∨B ≤ C'; Props_Cocartesian instantiates this in a genuine preorder (propositions under entailment), where the join is disjunction.
statement_record.strength_comparison: intree-stronger on the lub half (the UMP is uniqueness-carrying and holds in any category, not just thin ones), but intree-weaker overall: the ordered objects are arbitrary objects of a category, never partitions/systems, and the collapse 'coproduct in a poset = least upper bound' is asserted only in prose.
